errorCodes.meaning: No key this VTA can derive for the context has the PCS identifier `boundId`. The member asks the community's administrators for a reset (vtc/vetting/vetters/pcs-binding/reset/0.1).
A vetter engine for this community with the identifier `boundId` exists in another context the caller has standing over. Vet from that context; a key cannot move between contexts.
A vetter engine exists for this context and community under another member DID.
The engine's current key holds a class credential, tokens or attestations from the community. A key a community has issued to is never replaced.

schema.description: A vetter's client asks its VTA to restore the vetter key a community has bound the member to, when the vetter engine holds a different key or none. The VTA searches the keys it can derive for the context and, if one matches, makes it the engine's key.

boundId.description: The PCS identifier the community has bound to the member, as vtc/vetting/vetters/pcs-binding/show/0.1 returns it.

community.description: The community's DID: the helper whose parameters the engine runs under.

contextId.description: The context the engine belongs to. Only keys derived from this context's base are searched.

memberDid.description: The vetter's member DID in the community.
